description: Departures and arrivals at a railway station found by name or station code: the trains still to come by default, or every train of a station-local day with window day (the default when date is given). For each train, the other end of its journey, scheduled and recorded times in UTC, expected times and platforms where the railway publishes them, status, delay, operator and, when one is open, a link to its market; whether the board is live (expected times) and how fresh its source is; the coming hour's departures and cancellations, with the late count only on a live, fresh board (null otherwise); and a link to the station page on gaduin.com. Finds stations with a page on gaduin.com first, then any other station a stored train calls at (search_stations lists them).

date.description: Station-local date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today at the station.

limit.description: Max trains per direction (1-30). Defaults to 10; with window day, omit it to list the whole day.

network.description: The railway's country code to narrow the match, e.g. GB, US or CH.

station.description: Station name or code, e.g. London Paddington, PAD or Zürich HB.

window.description: upcoming (trains from now on) or day (every train of the date). Defaults to day when date is given, else upcoming.

name: get_station_board
title: Train station board
